meta.name: story-cover
meta.description: 小说封面生成。根据书名、作者名自动分析题材风格，调用 GPT-Image-2 生成含标题和署名的专业级网文封面；Codex CLI 优先使用内置 ImageGen，无需单独 API Key。触发方式：/story-cover、/封面、「帮我做个封面」「生成封面图」「做个小说封面」「封面设计」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入书名和作者，自动生成专业网文封面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想为网文生成专业封面而不懂设计
copy.tagline_en: Generate a novel cover with title and author from book info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a polished cover for your web novel

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按书名和笔名判断小说题材风格，调用 GPT-Image-2 生成自带书名、笔名的网文封面，再按目标平台的上传像素居中裁剪导出。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-cover、/封面，或说「帮我做个封面」等话时接管；封面尺寸与风格按目标平台确定。

say.text: 帮我做个小说封面，书名《九霄剑帝》，笔名青云
say.note: 会先判定题材，再生成含书名和笔名的封面

say.text: 生成封面图，用这张图片当参考图
say.note: 切到图生图通路生成封面

say.text: 再出一版不同构图，色调换成冷色
say.note: 重新生成并自增版本号，不覆盖旧图

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads your novel's title and pen name, picks a genre style, calls GPT-Image-2 to make a web-novel cover that already contains the title and author name, then crops it to your platform's upload size.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type /story-cover or /封面, or ask for a novel cover or cover design; cover size and style follow the target platform.

say_en.text: Make a novel cover: title 'Jiu Xiao Jian Di', pen name Qingyun
say_en.note: Judges the genre, then renders title and author name

say_en.text: Generate a cover image using this picture as reference
Give me another version with a different composition, cooler tones
say_en.note: Regenerates with a new version number, keeps the old file
